items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, I worked with Abby a lot. Worked with Abby a lot, little jobs.

ctx.x: What about Abby Williams? Did you ever work with Abby, Spann?

Yeah, I worked with Abby a lot. Worked with Abby a lot, little jobs. Where? Well down around Paul Good and Burgundy, and Paul Good around the corner in 59. When I first began to get into the air like that, I was working with him down there then.
I used to come to Thump and Manor's and hear you and dance, remember?
